context.requirement_text: ISS-0816 (queue task 816). CursorPage<T> declared a has_more field. No Letflow route emits has_more on the wire -- the issue's original premise that lib/letflow/audit.ex does was refuted by ISSUE-FIXER at Step 1, and docs/issues/ISS-0816.yaml carries the correction inline. The field therefore covered zero wire shapes, and two frontend call sites fabricated it client-side from Boolean(next_cursor) purely to satisfy the type they were declared to return. The fix is to delete the field, split the envelope along the axis the backend genuinely varies on (two-key {items, next_cursor} versus three-key {items, next_cursor, count}), retype every call site to the envelope its route actually emits, record the route-to-shape mapping so a later reader need not re-derive it, and close AC3's GroupsPage member-list truncation.
context.design_authority: lib/letflow/design/iss-0816-cursorpage-has-more-audit.md at commit bf4e7ded (revision 3), PASSED by CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR at commit 01467558 after two rejections. Implemented as specified; no design decision re-litigated.

task.description: WF-03 Step 3 (implement) for ISS-0816, building exactly what lib/letflow/design/iss-0816-cursorpage-has-more-audit.md specifies after that design passed a hard CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR gate on rework iteration 2. The work has five separable parts and one explicit anti-goal. Part one is the type correction: delete the fabricated field from CursorPage<T> so it becomes the exact two-key envelope {items, next_cursor}; add CountedCursorPage<T> as the three-key envelope {items, next_cursor, count}; give both docblocks the route-to-shape mapping of design section 2.2 so AC4's recording obligation is met in the type file and not only in the design document; collapse EntityRecordsPage and GroupMemberPage to aliases with their exported names retained so no call site churns; and leave TenantListResponse alone as a recorded deliberate non-change. Part two is the call-site retype: move audit, instances and both tasks routes to CountedCursorPage<T>, delete audit.ts's module-private RawAuditPage, and delete both client-side fabrication sites (audit.ts and promotions.ts), taking promotions.ts's whole now-identity .then mapping with them. Part three is modules.ts, which gets a provenance comment only and no type change, because /admin/modules and /admin/module-shares have no server at all (ISS-0822) and CursorPage<T> is the deliberate weakest claim there. Part four is AC3: groupsApi.members gains optional cursor/page_size, a new groupsApi.listAllMembers drains next_cursor under a bounded cap of 20 requests at 200 per page and reports truncated only when members were genuinely left unfetched, and GroupsPage consumes the drain so availableUsers -- a set difference, design INV-D -- is computed from the complete member set rather than page one of it. Part five is the recurrence backstop: a new T7 forbidlist entry named has-more-wire-field whose five-alternative regex matches the code forms of the field only, so a docblock may still name it in order to say it does not exist, plus T8's two GRD-UI-04 fixtures. The anti-goal: nothing outside this scope is touched -- not TimelineFeed's unrelated camelCase hasMore prop, not the other three ISS-0821 fixtures, not meta-control.spec.ts, and no existing forbidlist pattern or ISS-0765 assertion is weakened in any way to make anything pass.

finding_1.title: GroupsPage's member dialog spins the event loop indefinitely under real @tanstack/react-query in jsdom -- measured against the UNMODIFIED page, so it predates ISS-0816
finding_1.detail: T6 was first written with a real QueryClientProvider and the API module mocked (the InstancePinsPanel.test.tsx precedent), because that exercises the actual query the page issues. Rendering the page is fine; clicking Manage members opens the dialog correctly -- the select element is present in the DOM immediately after the click -- and then the event loop never yields again: a setTimeout(50) after the click never fires, --testTimeout cannot fire either, and the worker was measured burning roughly 110 percent of one core (node PID CPU 20s -> 28.8s over an 8-second window). It reproduces with the dialog's two queries stubbed to never-resolving promises, so it is not the drain resolving and not react-query refetching. DECISIVE MEASUREMENT: I checked out the UNMODIFIED web/src/pages/admin/GroupsPage.tsx from HEAD, re-ran the same probe with groupsApi.members mocked instead, and it hung identically. The loop therefore predates this run and is not caused by listAllMembers or by the truncation notice. It has no existing test coverage because there was no GroupsPage component test before this one. NOT FIXED HERE -- diagnosing a render loop in a page whose only in-scope change is one queryFn and one conditional notice is outside ISS-0816's scope, and the design does not authorise it. T6 was rewritten on the repo's other established pattern (useQuery/useMutation/useQueryClient mocked, as EntityCrudPage.test.tsx and DlqPage.pagination.test.tsx do), which renders the dialog in 121ms and still carries the assertion that matters: the useQuery double invokes the page's own queryFn, so a spy proves the page calls groupsApi.listAllMembers and never groupsApi.members. The new test file carries a header note recording all of this for the next agent. Recommend ORCH file it.

finding_3.title: Design section 7.1's 'mechanically pinned' sentence is false, as the gate already recorded
finding_3.detail: Section 7.1 claims the extended offender fixture pins each of T7's five alternatives so a future edit cannot silently drop one. It does not: meta-control asserts regex.test(content) over the whole fixture file, so any one surviving alternative satisfies it. The gate measured this by deleting alternative 4 and watching meta-control still pass 48/48. The fixture's specified CONTENTS are correct and were built exactly as written; only the guarantee is overstated. The offender fixture's own header now says so in plain terms, so the next reader of the fixture is not misled by the design text. meta-control.spec.ts was NOT edited -- out of scope, and ORCH has routed the sentence to DOC-UPDATER.
